sources.title: US스틸, DRI 플랜트 착공 ... 스크랩 의존도 감축
evidence: US스틸은 10월 30일, 아칸소주 오세올라의 전기로 사업장인 빅리버 2 공장에서 직접환원철(DRI) 플랜트 기공식을 가졌다.
연간 생산능력 250만 톤 규모의 DRI 플랜트 신설은 지난 4월에 결정된 것이다.
19억 달러에 달하는 이번 투자를 통해 US스틸이 그 야심찬 목표의 실현을 뒷받침해 줄 것

sources.title: Lundin cuts copper outlook again as wild Chile weather bites
evidence: Lundin Mining (TSX: LUN) has lowered its 2026 copper production forecast
The Canadian miner cut Caserones’ full-year guidance to 105,000–115,000 tonnes from 120,000–130,000 tonnes
Severe winter storms suspended operations at Caserones for about 30 days during the third quarter
Lundin produced 62,610 tonnes of copper in the three months ended Sept. 30

sources.title: Tankers hit in Hormuz as Iran keeps up pressure after US vote
evidence: Iran reported three more tankers had been damaged in the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday
At least five vessels have reported incidents since Sunday, according to UK maritime security agency UKMTO
said two tankers had struck naval mines and another had caught fire on Thursday.
A senior Iranian official said this week that the two sides remain far apart.
Qatar said on Tuesday that the United States and Iran were committed to mediation efforts and were reviewing proposals
